argument: The archive must be carried by downstream agent geometry, not by the coral rings. Hide the witnesses and ask whether the crowd still bends.
The field needs one unmistakable kink at the first capture before four channels accumulate; density must not dissolve causality into an attractive mesh.
Capturing at two different points should produce two different downstream routes, while lifting the latest capture must return the exact prior agent field.
WebGPU readiness is not an artwork. Delete v001 if the adapter label or archive counters carry more meaning than the mass itself.
